summary: Flat quiet-street kerb past a corner, backed by sheds with homes behind.
reasons: Backed by sheds and carport, homes 20+ m

best_section.where: north kerb of Raglan Street, 20 m past the Indooroopilly Road corner, backed by garden sheds

drivers.seclusion: Sheds and a carport sit 7-21 m behind the kerb; the nearest dwelling is 27 m away, but homes at 5 m and 9 m flank the section.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a street wide enough for parked cars; no lay-by.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street; the busy Indooroopilly Road is at the corner.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; signs ban stopping and parking only at the corner.

flags: No Parking Any Time and No Stopping Any Time signs at the corner; check where they end
Dwellings 5-12 m from the kerb at 0-15 m and 36-75 m
Plain kerb, no parking convention for overnight stays
sun_shade: Trees and hedge shade the north side in the afternoon; open to the park on the south.
